prompt:
An ivy-covered stone pub on a village street corner at dusk, slate roof against a deep blue sky, warm light in the windows, lanterns either side of the front door, a street lamp on the left, the empty road in the foreground. The camera creeps forward very slowly toward the lit doorway, almost imperceptibly. Faint wisps of mist rise and drift low over the tarmac; the window light breathes and flickers gently; the hanging pub sign sways a fraction in a light breeze; the sky darkens by the smallest degree. Everything else stays still. Same building, same light, the street empty, the picture clean. Quiet, photographic dusk.
Thanks.
